meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将实现任务自动拆分为可合并的PR并完成全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将开发任务拆成多个独立PR并自动走完提交流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate full PR lifecycle from task decomposition to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to split development tasks into independent PRs and automate the submission process

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会把一项任务拆成多个最小的可独立合并 PR;每个 PR 在独立工作区中实现,要求手动测试并留证据,再写英文 PR 说明,反复跑 CI 和 Cubic 检查直到通过(配额用完可跳过 Cubic),最后默认自动合并并清理。
howto.when: 当你说“创建 PR”“实现并提 PR”“处理 issue 并提 PR”等要求,或语境表明要产出 PR 时触发。

say.text: 把这个 issue 拆成最小可合并的 PR,分别提审。
say.note: 会按依赖拆分并各建工作区并发开发。

say.text: 实现这个功能,每个 PR 都要附手动测试证据再提 PR。
say.note: 未留证据不会提交或推送。

say.text: 创建 PR,跑 CI 和 Cubic,通过后自动合并并清理。
say.note: Cubic 仅在配额耗尽时跳过。

howto.what_en: Splits a task into smallest independently mergeable PRs; implements each in a fresh worktree with evidence-bound manual QA, creates an English PR, loops CI + Cubic until passing (Cubic skipped only on quota exhaustion), then auto-merges and cleans up.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'land this as a PR', etc., or when context implies PR delivery (e.g. saying 'implement X').

say_en.text: Split this issue into the smallest mergeable PRs and open them.
say_en.note: Builds independent PRs concurrently, ordered by dependency.

say_en.text: Implement this feature; each PR needs manual QA evidence before you push.
say_en.note: No evidence file means no commit or push.

say_en.text: Open a PR, run CI and Cubic, then auto-merge and clean up.
say_en.note: Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted.
